name: Regime + non-extreme VIX confluence arms momentum (macro composite beyond a vix-level filter)
rationale: THESIS: macro_regime (FRED curve+rates+liquidity composite) and vix_level (implied equity vol) are both BOUNDED risk gauges, but they measure different things — the composite is a SLOW structural tide (rates/curve/liquidity), VIX is a FAST fear spike. A risk-on composite tells you the structural tape rewards risk; a non-extreme VIX tells you there is no acute panic right now. Requiring BOTH should catch the case where the structural regime is fine but a vol spike is about to chop momentum, and the case where VIX is calm but the structural tide has already turned out. Entry: macro_regime>floor AND vix_level<vix_ceiling AND ret_Nd>mom_floor. DISCONFIRMER: run the SAME entry with macro_regime DROPPED but the vix_level ceiling kept (vix-only gated momentum). If the vix-only version reproduces the macro+vix net-of-fee Sharpe, the macro composite is collinear with implied vol and carries no incremental info beyond a VIX filter — falsified. The composite must add edge over the VIX-only gate.
catalyst: Structural macro regime risk-on AND implied vol non-extreme AND trend up — both the slow tide and the fast fear gauge align to arm momentum.
